summary: CoastalSouth Bancshares, Inc. disclosed on Form 8-K that its Board of Directors authorized a $15 million stock repurchase plan, effective May 1, 2026, through April 30, 2027. The plan allows open-market, accelerated share repurchase, or privately negotiated purchases under Rule 10b-18 and Rule 10b5-1 trading plans. No specific price, premium, or share count is disclosed. The company is not obligated to repurchase any shares and may modify or discontinue the plan at any time. Watch for periodic repurchase activity and potential EPS accretion; no risk-arb angle as this is an issuer capital return.
